sampling: approximately class-balanced: for each label c in 0..C-1, shuffle that label's positional indices with numpy.random.default_rng(seed) and take floor(N/C); then shuffle the concatenation with the same generator
note: Positional indices into the HuggingFace train split. Tokenization does not reorder rows, so these indices are valid before or after preprocessing. Every method at a given (task, N, seed) uses this same subset.
